[EN] Mission Orders

Thulsa's manipulated the wendigos and turned them against us. We have to kill them to secure our hold on the Vale of Spires.

Kill the dominated wendigo {@LinkCreature:51#1011#ragers}, {@LinkCreature:51#1021#warlords}, and {@LinkCreature:51#1031#shamans}.

Report to Raneria in Habere when mission is complete.
[ES] Órdenes de misión

Thulsa ha manipulado a los wendigos y los ha vuelto en nuestra contra. Tenemos que matarlos para asegurar nuestro control sobre Vale of Spires.

Mata a los wendigos dominados {@LinkCreature:51#1011#ragers}, {@LinkCreature:51#1021#warlords} y {@LinkCreature:51#1031#shamans}.

Preséntate ante Raneria en Habere cuando la misión esté completa.

[EN] You've earned the thanks of the federation! Your guild is an inspiration to all!
[ES] ¡Te has ganado el agradecimiento de la federación! ¡Tu gremio es una inspiración para todos!

[EN] It looks like you haven't completed your mission yet.
[ES] Parece que aún no has completado tu misión.
